name: HandBrake Converter
description: Converts your library in the background with HandBrakeCLI: automatically on a schedule or title by title, keeping the original look.
overview: Converts your library in the background with HandBrakeCLI: automatically on a schedule or title by title, keeping the original look.

versions.changelog: Subtitles keep their look (styled subtitles stay as made, plain ones follow your Jellyfin subtitle settings, every result is checked) and never come out giant; simpler subtitle settings; audio copied when already right; no cropping; 10-bit kept or 8-bit by choice; one suggestion per dropdown from your own playback; Tools tab with Check a title; fixed duplicate episodes with a wrong series name after replacing originals; a subtitle that only lives in a separate file can no longer be lost if that file can't be written; new Tools > Repair giant subtitles finds and repairs giant subtitles made by older versions (MOV_TEXT at a styled track's size, SRT with font size tags) without re-encoding, and SRT is now always written without font tags so it follows your Jellyfin subtitle size; Dolby Atmos and DTS:X tracks are always copied; Auto-convert skips videos already in the chosen format; new Tools > Update suggestions reads the newest transcode logs with a progress bar; settings that clash (for example keeping HDR with an H.264 encoder) are marked in bold red with a note above Save, without changing anything; new Quick apply at the top of the settings sets video, audio, subtitles and container for a chosen official Jellyfin app (from Jellyfin's codec support list), with HD and 4K models of Roku, Android TV / Fire TV, Apple TV and Xbox listed separately; the page is cut to five tabs (Status, Libraries, Convert titles, Settings, Tools) with folding sections.
